spec.description: Access control metrics dashboard for MCP traffic.

spec.expr: sum by (mcp_method) (count_over_time({container="airlock-microgateway-engine", pod=~"${gateway_pod:regex}"} |= "envoy.access" | json log_type="event.dataset", mcp_method="mcp.method", mcp_tool="mcp.tool_name", user_id="airlock.access_control.user_id", authorized="airlock.access_control.authorized", domain="url.domain", url="url.path", client_ip="network.forwarded_ip", route_kind="airlock.route.kind", route_ns="airlock.route.namespace", route_name="airlock.route.name" | log_type = `envoy.access` | mcp_method != "" | label_format route=`{{ .route_kind | lower }}/{{ .route_ns }}/{{ .route_name }}` | route =~ `${route:regex}` [$__auto]))

spec.description: Number of MCP requests per MCP method (JSON-RPC method) over time.
spec.title: MCP Requests by Method

spec.expr: topk(10, sum by (mcp_tool) (count_over_time({container="airlock-microgateway-engine", pod=~"${gateway_pod:regex}"} |= "envoy.access" | json log_type="event.dataset", mcp_method="mcp.method", mcp_tool="mcp.tool_name", user_id="airlock.access_control.user_id", authorized="airlock.access_control.authorized", domain="url.domain", url="url.path", client_ip="network.forwarded_ip", route_kind="airlock.route.kind", route_ns="airlock.route.namespace", route_name="airlock.route.name" | log_type = `envoy.access` | mcp_method != "" | label_format route=`{{ .route_kind | lower }}/{{ .route_ns }}/{{ .route_name }}` | route =~ `${route:regex}` | mcp_method = `tools/call` [$__range])))

spec.description: The top 10 MCP tools by number of tools/call requests.
spec.title: Top 10 MCP Tools

spec.expr: topk(10, sum by (user_id) (count_over_time({container="airlock-microgateway-engine", pod=~"${gateway_pod:regex}"} |= "envoy.access" | json log_type="event.dataset", mcp_method="mcp.method", mcp_tool="mcp.tool_name", user_id="airlock.access_control.user_id", authorized="airlock.access_control.authorized", domain="url.domain", url="url.path", client_ip="network.forwarded_ip", route_kind="airlock.route.kind", route_ns="airlock.route.namespace", route_name="airlock.route.name" | log_type = `envoy.access` | mcp_method != "" | label_format route=`{{ .route_kind | lower }}/{{ .route_ns }}/{{ .route_name }}` | route =~ `${route:regex}` | user_id != "" [$__range])))

spec.description: The top 10 users (JWT subject;issuer) by number of MCP requests.
spec.title: Top 10 Users

spec.expr: topk(10, sum by (endpoint) (count_over_time({container="airlock-microgateway-engine", pod=~"${gateway_pod:regex}"} |= "envoy.access" | json log_type="event.dataset", mcp_method="mcp.method", mcp_tool="mcp.tool_name", user_id="airlock.access_control.user_id", authorized="airlock.access_control.authorized", domain="url.domain", url="url.path", client_ip="network.forwarded_ip", route_kind="airlock.route.kind", route_ns="airlock.route.namespace", route_name="airlock.route.name" | log_type = `envoy.access` | mcp_method != "" | label_format route=`{{ .route_kind | lower }}/{{ .route_ns }}/{{ .route_name }}` | route =~ `${route:regex}` | label_format endpoint=`{{ .domain }}{{ .url }}` [$__range])))

spec.description: Number of MCP requests per endpoint (URL domain and path as logged). If the route rewrites the host, allowed requests show the upstream host.
spec.title: MCP Requests by Endpoint

spec.expr: sum by (user_id, mcp_tool) (count_over_time({container="airlock-microgateway-engine", pod=~"${gateway_pod:regex}"} |= "envoy.access" | json log_type="event.dataset", mcp_method="mcp.method", mcp_tool="mcp.tool_name", user_id="airlock.access_control.user_id", authorized="airlock.access_control.authorized", domain="url.domain", url="url.path", client_ip="network.forwarded_ip", route_kind="airlock.route.kind", route_ns="airlock.route.namespace", route_name="airlock.route.name" | log_type = `envoy.access` | mcp_method != "" | label_format route=`{{ .route_kind | lower }}/{{ .route_ns }}/{{ .route_name }}` | route =~ `${route:regex}` | mcp_method = `tools/call` | user_id != "" [$__range]))

spec.description: Number of tools/call requests per user and MCP tool.
spec.title: MCP Tool Calls by User

spec.expr: sum by (mcp_method, mcp_tool, client_ip) (count_over_time({container="airlock-microgateway-engine", pod=~"${gateway_pod:regex}"} |= "envoy.access" | json log_type="event.dataset", mcp_method="mcp.method", mcp_tool="mcp.tool_name", user_id="airlock.access_control.user_id", authorized="airlock.access_control.authorized", domain="url.domain", url="url.path", client_ip="network.forwarded_ip", route_kind="airlock.route.kind", route_ns="airlock.route.namespace", route_name="airlock.route.name" | log_type = `envoy.access` | mcp_method != "" | label_format route=`{{ .route_kind | lower }}/{{ .route_ns }}/{{ .route_name }}` | route =~ `${route:regex}` | authorized = `false` [$__range]))

spec.description: MCP requests that were not authorized, per MCP method, MCP tool and client IP. Requests without a valid JWT carry no user ID.
spec.title: Non Authorized MCP Requests

spec.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {container="airlock-microgateway-engine", pod=~"${gateway_pod:regex}"} |= "envoy.access" | json log_type="event.dataset", mcp_method="mcp.method", mcp_tool="mcp.tool_name", user_id="airlock.access_control.user_id", authorized="airlock.access_control.authorized", domain="url.domain", url="url.path", client_ip="network.forwarded_ip", route_kind="airlock.route.kind", route_ns="airlock.route.namespace", route_name="airlock.route.name" | log_type = `envoy.access` | mcp_method != "" | label_format route=`{{ .route_kind | lower }}/{{ .route_ns }}/{{ .route_name }}` | route =~ `${route:regex}` | mcp_method = `tools/call` | json duration="event.duration" | unwrap duration [$__auto]) by (mcp_tool)

spec.description: 95th percentile of the request duration of tools/call requests per MCP tool.
spec.title: MCP Tool Call Duration (p95)
